params.name: search
params.description: Search query with advanced operators. Supports + (AND), | (OR), - (NOT), "..." (phrase), * (prefix), () (grouping), \ (escape). URL-encode when using special characters.

params.name: search_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to search. Options: title, description, keywords, main_text.

params.name: locale
params.description: Comma-separated country codes to filter articles by locale (e.g., us,ca,gb). Supports 50+ countries.

params.name: categories
params.description: Comma-separated list of categories to include. Options: general, science, sports, business, health, entertainment, tech, politics, food, travel.

params.name: exclude_categories
params.description: Comma-separated list of categories to exclude.

params.name: domains
params.description: Comma-separated list of source domains to include (e.g., techcrunch.com,bbc.com).

params.name: exclude_domains
params.description: Comma-separated list of source domains to exclude.

params.name: source_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of source IDs to include (as returned by the /news/sources endpoint).

params.name: exclude_source_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of source IDs to exclude.

params.name: language
params.description: Comma-separated language codes to filter results (e.g., en,es,fr). Supports 35+ languages.

params.name: published_before
params.description: Return articles published before this date/time (UTC). Formats: Y-m-d\TH:i:s, Y-m-d\TH:i, Y-m-d\TH, Y-m-d, Y-m, Y.

params.name: published_after
params.description: Return articles published after this date/time (UTC). Formats: Y-m-d\TH:i:s, Y-m-d\TH:i, Y-m-d\TH, Y-m-d, Y-m, Y.

params.name: published_on
params.description: Return articles published on this exact date (UTC). Format: Y-m-d.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order for results. Options: published_on (chronological), relevance_score (by search relevance).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Upper bound is determined by the current plan.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination. Maximum total of 20,000 results across all pages.
